data.name: Block Story™
data.detailed_description:
Notas da Atualização

V 14.0

*******

Reforged

***

Menu Changes

Male/Female Option
Custom Keybindings
Controller Support
Resolution Options
Full Screen/Windowed Mode
New World Creation Options - Default, Old, Flat, and Void
The ability to rename your character and change the gender of existing characters
Added Wiki.gg and Reddit to the menu Credits Page

Mob Shaders

Creatures no longer glow in the dark. They adapt to the light around them

Locations

Space Layer 5 - The Nebula A new biome above Space Layer 4 that spawns beautiful Nebulas that you can fly through with procedurally generated planets that sometimes have rings and moons.

Space Layer 6 - The Deep Void A deep and dark space layer. It's deep and dark that rarely spawns in procedurally generated asteroids with ores, craters, and new resources.

Moria - Added Moria into the current terrain generator. It can be found in the lower halves of caves in chunks. Moria will contain chests with new loot pools.

Floating Islands - Added Floating islands that can be found just under the forgotten sky Forgotten Sky and Hades received texture revamps The Ocean now has Seagrass, Kelp, Seaweed, and more!

Forgotten Sky and Hades received texture revamps

The Ocean now has Seagrass, Kelp, Seaweed, and more!

Paint

Painting has been redone to support all blocks and most items!

Blocks

For the longest time, this game had a block type limit of 256 blocks. We couldn't add anymore because of this. I'm happy to announce that this issue has been resolved and the new limit is well over 64,000!

Over 50 New Blocks and Items have been added

Many blocks saw retextures Fancy texture pack was remastered

Retextured the Ai generated blocks

New Resources

Nebula Rock
Nebula Cloud
Asteroid Stone
Star Core
Dark Matter
Obsidian
Obsidian Shard

Creative Mode Update

The block count doesn’t lower
Durability for all weapons and items has been removed
The Creative Mode Menu has been alphabetised
All Mob Spawners are now in Creative Mode
The Trash Icon will now wipe your inventory if you click on it

Music

Removed all of the Ai Generated Tracks and added 8 new tracks made by humans
Main Menu Extended
Space Layer 1
Theme Space Layer 2 Theme
Space Layer 4 Theme
Phoenix Boss Theme
Cave Theme
Moria Theme
Hades Theme

Audio

400+ new sounds Creature idle sounds
Creature Impact sounds
NPC's can hum when you talk to them
Weapons all have unique sounds for equipping, swinging, and impact
Biomes now have atmospheric sounds
More new weather sounds

Balance Overhaul

Rebalanced all 147 creatures
Space Creatures got a heavy nerf but an XP buff
Enemies will no longer heal from magic attacks, instead they will resist attacks
You can now play any playstyle against any enemy

New Creatures

Space Wren - Can be found in Space Layer 4. It drops ocean items
Stormbringer - A new powerful elemental that can be found in the forgotten sky
Frog - Can be found in rivers and green fields
Umbrosk - Found in the depths of Moria
Glaciros - Found in the icy Tundra
Ember Tyr - Found in the fiery depths of Hades
Seraphax - Bringing a certain critter to Forgotten Sky
Zerath - Something is hidden in the stoney peaks of the Desert Mountains
Rat - A little creature found in the greens and caves
Crescent Ray - a crescent shaped moon found in the Nebulas
Orbis Felix - A giant space whale found in the Deep Void

Immersion

Leaves and Grass blow in the wind Interactive Grass and Plants Fire now displays on the tops and bottom of blocks

Misc

Linux Support
MacOS Support
Pet Space Suit - New Pet Space Suit that will allow any pet to survive up in space!
Sand physics were redone from scratch and now fall smoothly
Critical Hits - There is a 5% chance for you or your pet to land a hit that does 15% more damage. It will also throw back your enemy
Mobs will now fade in and out when they spawn and despawn
New Armor Set - Cosmic Armor
The Amber Armor set has had its stats changed to be directed more for end game melee players
The Cosmic Armor set is directed to be for end game magic users
Fire damage has been nerfed
Water will now put you out
Water will put out blocks
Acid will now behave like water
Breaking blocks on fire will put them out
Magic damage will no longer stack on the player
Pets max level has been increased from 50 to 60
Many creatures have had their HP, Damage, and XP drops changed
Added new passives to some weapons and armor sets
27 new Achievements
You can’t pause the game to stop your fall
Players can now disable Creature Nametags and stats
Gontar can breathe in space
Angel Goblin will not heal Ashkore
The daily Amber Brick quest is no longer a daily quest
The 2 quests that require you to level up your dragons to level 50 have been lowered to level 30
Disabled knockback
All items are in Creative Mode
Leaves and Grass blow in the wind Interactive Grass and Plants Fire now displays on the tops and bottom of blocks
Destroying blocks doesn't leave behind shadows anymore
Wizard now spawns in the old world
The OG spawners appear in the old world
Removed Player File Encryption
Removed Il2cpp so people can mod the game
Separated FPS from Jumping
Breaking your most recently placed bed will reset your spawn point
The Miner Helmet is brighter
Crafting colored paint brushes will now have full durability instead of just 1
Redid the system that adds more HP, Mana, and Hunger Resistance to the player if you’re holding items that do this. If you have full health and pick up a Dragon Shield that gives you 200 more HP, you’ll still have full health.
Breathing recovers much faster
Earthquakes are more rare
Mati’s spawn rate was lowered
Flowers can now be seen through glass
Removed Scrape Damage
Translations are updated across all languages

Setting to disable music change until it finishes playing

Fixed textures on terrain quality 5

Fixed inventory

Updated the game engine to the latest version

Improved save logic to prevent character breakage

New block Sentinel's Branch (prevents creatures from spawning)

Tumbleweed

Fixed daily quests

Fixed errors where items disappeared from inventory

Pet resurrection confirmation window

New ability for the Swamp Golem

After death in survival and hardcore modes, items lie 3 times longer

New music for boss battles

Fixed many bugs and imperfections

V 13.2.2

*******

Mass build for Replicator and Destroyer in Creative mode (can be found in creative settings menu)

Some fixes and improvements

V 13.2.1

*******

Fixed earthquake

V 13.2.0

*******

Fixed a bug where the New Year's hat could be displayed on the Gontar pet

Heavy Metal swords no longer drop in Hardcore and Survival

Coins for trading

Coins may fall out when digging blocks

Recipe for melting coins in a furnace

Ability to purchase more than one item at a time in stores

Fixed display of dragon armor in the Alchemist shop

Grass does not grow or spread if it is painted

The bat spawns in caves

Explosions now ignite fireworks

Fixed game icon

Fixed distortion of the sound of melodies when the character moves quickly

Shadow Ax now restores 1 mana per second instead of 10

Fixed recipes for Ashkor, Xordaraxus and Dragonlord

Fixed opening inventory of Cats and Dogs

Miner's helmet gives 15 armor

V 13.1.1

*******

Reduced grass growth in world generation

Fixed duck and seaweed spawner digging

Fixed damage of fireballs and rockets of hostile creatures from any distance

Improved cloud animation

Drops now last twice as long

Added smoke from aircraft exhaust pipes

Added a button with a link to the channel in Discord in the main menu

Some building improvements, jungle biome and other changes

V 13.1.0

*******

New preset pixel texture pack

Electricity and many new blocks to create complex mechanisms

Spawners, dynamite, fireworks, doors and many other blocks can be activated with a click or electricity

New transport aircraft

Stick and wall clock block

Musical blocks

Painting amber blocks

The grass grows automatically

The character can climb chains and vines

Cobweb, swamp and lava slows down the player

Rotation of triangular blocks and hatches

UI improvements

Improved weather and fog performance

New more realistic sky

Coloring the sky in different colors when summoning magical creatures

Skull block activation toggles weather

Knockback effect when taking damage

Improved some digging and block setting mechanics

Fixed wheat work

The hoe now turns grass to earth

Blocks destroyed by explosion now drop loot and activate physics

Rockets destroy blocks

Particles of lights on lava

Ash effect in hell

New achievements and mysteries

Reconstruction of buildings

New hidden chests

Many bug fixes and improvements

V 13.0.8

Show vehicles on radar

Improved Dropbox backup

Many bug fixes

*******

New Survival Game Mode

New Dragon Eldriar Pet

New Transport Locomotive

Vehicles are now saved in the game world

Vehicle painting

New block Railway dead end

Improved models of some creatures

Pet Armor

In the chests found in the game world you can find useful items

Inventory item destroy button

Backups via Dropbox

Meteorites

Recalculated the level of the main character

New achievements

New types of achievements

Many bugs fixed


Acerca do jogo

Build a world of vast landscapes where you have ultimate control. You decide where to go and what to build. Fly on dragons and other creatures as you embark on an epic quest to save the world.

Block Story® combines popular 3D block building, sandbox exploration gameplay with exciting and addictive role playing game elements. Complete quests to conquer diverse biomes and become the greatest warrior in the realm. Build strongholds, encounter a wide variety of creatures, battle boss monsters, and mine valuable resources to upgrade weaponry, access better equipment and create artifacts to summon monsters of all sorts -- including dragons! The first chapter of your story begins...

Key Features

  • Discover several totally new and exciting quests

  • Learn from a wise Wizard on how to discover the many wonders of Block Story

  • Ride on dragons and more then 30 other creatures

  • Earn free diamonds for playing four days in a row

  • Infinite hours of RPG exploration game play

  • Explore numerous biomes from desert wastelands to arctic mountain ranges and even space! But look out for the dragons

  • Encounter numerous supporting characters that will assist you on your quests.

  • Level up your hero with customized stats and attributes

  • Use the crafting system to forge a slew of magical items – from lighting swords, mystical staves and rare artifacts that summon dragons and other creatures that will aid you in battle

  • Build different mechanisms with the new electrical system

  • Create a variety of mechanical vehicles from a simple boat and railroad to an airplane that will allow you to soar through the skies

  • Solve complex mysteries

  • And much more!

data.short_description: There isn’t much better than a wide open game world in which you have essentially no limits and can alter the very landscape in which you play – that is, unless you add dragons, of course…

reviews.review: a childhood game that gave me a chance to play rip off minecraft when i couldnt afford one back then, now  that im an adult, id still prefer this more than anything
